figurative_meaning_en: distinguished by or surrounded on all four sides
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের চৌপল চারপার্শ্বে ঘন জঙ্গলে ঘেরা।
এই বাড়িটি চৌপলের মতো চারদিক থেকে নিরাপদে রক্ষিত।
example_sentences_in_english: The village chaupal is surrounded by dense forests on all sides.
This house is secured on all four sides like a chaupal.
history: চৌপল is a traditional raised platform in Bengali villages used for community meetings and panchayat gatherings, symbolizing a central, surrounded space in rural life.
note: Refers to a village square or platform, often used figuratively for enclosed or centrally located areas.
